landing.heroTitle: What if your pattern is not the problem?
landing.heroBody: Scroll into the mirror. Notice the protection. Then take the questionnaire to discover the protective role shaping the way you love, protect, heal, and become.

storyBeats.title: Maybe you call it overthinking.
storyBeats.body: But the body may be doing something more intelligent: preparing, proving, pleasing, or disappearing before old discomfort returns.
storyBeats.reveal: The quiz starts where generic advice usually stops.

storyBeats.title: There is a reason your pattern repeats.
storyBeats.body: Each answer helps reveal the protection style underneath your reactions, the one that once kept something tender safe.
storyBeats.reveal: Protection is not the enemy. It is the doorway.

storyBeats.title: Your report names the pattern without making you small.
storyBeats.body: You receive a protective role, shadow clues, dream sabotage themes, and practices that feel personal enough to keep reading.

landing.bridgeEyebrow: The question that changes the scroll
landing.bridgeTitle: Which part of you learned to keep watch?
landing.bridgeBody: The questionnaire is built like a conversation with that part. It asks enough to create recognition, but not so much that you feel analyzed.

faqs.question: How long does it take?
faqs.answer: Most people complete it in 10 to 15 minutes. It is reflective, but not endless.

faqs.question: Is this therapy?
faqs.answer: No. It is a self-reflection tool, not a diagnosis or a replacement for therapy, medical care, or crisis support.

faqs.question: What do I get after the questionnaire?
faqs.answer: A personalized report with your dominant protective role, secondary pattern, shadow themes, dream sabotage clues, and practices.

anticipator.name: The Watcher
anticipator.coreProtection: staying alert so nothing catches you off guard
anticipator.bodyStrategy: scanning ahead, reading the room, running scenarios, and staying ready
anticipator.promise: If I anticipate, I stay safe.
anticipator.currency: anxiety, vigilance, and the energy spent preparing for what may never happen
practices: 60-second orienting practice: name five neutral things in the room before solving anything.
Journal: What is actually happening now, and what am I preparing for?
Body scan for present safety: jaw, shoulders, ribs, belly, feet.
Choose one small plan to pause before adding another contingency.

performer.name: The Striver
performer.coreProtection: earning safety through achievement, usefulness, and proof
performer.bodyStrategy: producing, improving, optimizing, and staying impressive
performer.promise: If I achieve, I stay worthy.
performer.currency: achievement, urgency, self-improvement, and rest that has to be earned
practices: Rest without earning practice: take ten minutes before completing the next useful thing.
Unfinished task tolerance: leave one low-stakes task incomplete for an evening.
Pleasure before productivity: let the body receive something beautiful first.
Journal: Who am I when nothing is being proven?

harmonizer.name: The Harmonizer
harmonizer.coreProtection: preserving connection by tracking others and softening yourself
harmonizer.bodyStrategy: peacemaking, caretaking, staying small, and sensing what others need
harmonizer.promise: If I harmonize, I stay loved.
harmonizer.currency: belonging, self-silencing, emotional labor, and the cost of not disappointing anyone
practices: One honest no: choose a low-stakes place to let a clean no exist.
Belonging without performance reflection: what connection remains when I stop managing it?
Hand-on-heart self-expression: say one true sentence out loud before editing it.
Track the difference between generosity and fear-driven caretaking.

quiter.name: The Shield
quiter.bodyStrategy: withdrawing, sleeping, losing interest, slowing down, and avoiding pressure
quiter.promise: If I withdraw, I preserve myself.
quiter.currency: withdrawal, depletion, postponed desire, and the quiet grief of stopping at the threshold
practices: Tiny next step practice: choose one action that takes less than three minutes.
Energy permission ritual: place a hand on the body and name what is genuinely available today.
Gentle movement before avoidance: one song, one walk, one stretch, no performance.
Journal: What pressure is my body trying to escape?

orientation.title: Your nervous system learned how to protect you before it knew how to choose.
orientation.body: The first 25 years of life, your body was focused on survival. This audit helps you see what protection formed, how it shows up now, and what identity may be emerging beyond it.

audit-focus.title: We begin with what brought you here.
audit-focus.body: No need to make the answer polished. Let the current loop, longing, or friction show us where the old protection is asking to be understood.

why-now.prompt: In one sentence, what made you book this audit right now?

stuck-areas.prompt: Where do you feel most stuck or most "looping" in your life currently?

first-25.title: Now we map the world your body adapted to.
first-25.body: Children read more than words. They read pressure, silence, image, fragility, and what must not be needed. This section gives language to the role your younger self learned to play.
